answer: Vouch liability: a new agent only earns after an established member vouches for it, locking 500 tokens that are slashed if the newcomer is later caught colluding. Each vouch is a costly signal, and the ledger becomes an atlas of who backed whom, so one exposed sybil burns its sponsor too. A ring of 100 fakes needs 50,000 tokens at risk plus 100 sponsors willing to lose them, leaving no cheap haven for spawned identities.
